audit_kind: Source/manifest-only runtime classification; no build, tests or emulator execution

scope.move_ids: Canonical nonzero equipped IDs 1..467 exactly once
scope.native_runtime: Current pokeplatinum/src/arena renderer and combat rules only; downloaded/source inventory and runtime wiring are separate questions.
scope.optional_pose_scope: Species-specific extra poses, hurt/charge reactions and move-specific actor choreography are optional presentation work. MELEE/RUSH already use actor poses, body motion and event-driven contact; 151 motion moves do not imply 151 missing projectile sprites.
scope.unique_art_limit: Only Swift is classed here as a clearly move-specific primary projectile sprite. A shared family or sole current user of a family is not proof of unique authored move art.
scope.mechanics_visual_separation: Visual coverage and native effect support are independent. An unsupported status move can still show a colored cone, HIT cone, body animation, windup puff or supplemental leaf.

visual_status_definitions.move_specific_sprite: Swift has its own sourced star sprite in the current renderer.
visual_status_definitions.shared_sprite_family: A colored atlas or matching elemental beam family is already drawn; this does not establish unique art for this move.
visual_status_definitions.generic_hit_cone: The launch/effect path repeats the shared HIT puff along a cone; this is generic visible feedback.
visual_status_definitions.body_motion_contact: Actor attack/rush motion and event-driven contact art are the intended current presentation; a projectile sprite is not automatically required.
visual_status_definitions.conditional_status_feedback: SELF profile has a direct native effect adapter; feedback depends on applying that effect and may use shared stage/guard/status art or only the generic application puff.
visual_status_definitions.self_generic_no_native_effect: SELF profile has no direct native status adapter; actor action and windup puffs still render, and some profiles have supplemental leaf art. Splash intentionally has no damage or extra effect.
visual_status_definitions.neutral_water_beam_fallback: This beam uses the WATER strip converted to two neutral gray/white colors; its own beam identity is not authored.
visual_status_definitions.primitive_orb_placeholder: Projectile uses an 8x8 type-colored primitive orb and optional orb trail; not a move-specific sprite.
visual_status_definitions.shared_swift_star_fallback_review: A non-Swift projectile currently shares the Swift star sprite because STAR dispatch returns before type dispatch. Review per move; this assignment alone does not prove stars are inappropriate.

interpretation_notes: Forty-one primary fallback assignments to review =32 non-Swift star projectiles +9 neutral-WATER beams. These are separate from35 primitive orb placeholders. A star may fit some moves; fallback assignment alone is not proof every star is wrong.
Sixty-eight HIT cones are visibly drawn; contact puffs are being reused as launch/status art.
Seventy-one SELF primary profiles split into42 with direct native adapters and29 without. Even the latter retain actor animation and generic windup HIT puffs; Ingrain also has LEAF follow-through.
Every supported ApplyStatus effect emits COMBAT_RING, whose render fallback is a shared HIT puff for its first eight ticks. Healing does not have a dedicated heal sprite dispatch.

BUFF/DEBUFF is conditional on an actual observed stage delta, GUARD on guardTimer, and recurring condition overlays on the applied major status. Confusion uses confusionTicks and has no recurring confusion-specific overlay.
SLASH/LEAF supplemental follow-through is independent of primary profile kind; it can accompany MELEE/RUSH, projectile, cone and SELF moves, including unsupported Ingrain.
Current status adapter count matches the existing coverage artifact:81 implemented direct adapters and89 no native status adapter. No claim of full retail move-script support is made.
Splash is deliberately harmless. Its lack of a native status adapter is an inventory fact, not a broken-mechanics finding or a requirement to add attack effects.
